# Garten: Cozy Farm & Bakery

> Cozy offline farm game for Android by Gartenwerk Games, an independent solo developer from Germany. Plays without internet, no in-app purchases; ads are optional rewarded videos only. Languages: English, German, Russian. Status (October 2026): closed testing on Google Play, public release coming soon.

Also known as: "Garten: Gemütliche Farm" (German), "Garten: уютная ферма" (Russian).

- Grandma left you her overgrown farm and her diary: grow crops (wheat to watermelons), sell at the stalls.
- Hire helpers: the farm keeps earning while the game is closed (relaxing idle farm).
- Bakery: help the village baker in a match-3 mini-game; also cook pickles and jam, foggy mazes.
- Neighbors with their own stories; daily goals; short 5–10 minute sessions.
- Achievements and cloud saves with Google Play Games.
